run_license_check: run the license checker against pyproject.toml and uv.lock to verify all dependency licenses
run_license_check_requirements: run the license checker against a custom requirements file to verify dependency licenses
check_package_license: check if a specific package version has an acceptable license using the LicenseChecker
fetch_pypi_license: fetch the license string for a package version from the PyPI JSON API
normalize_package_name: normalize a package name so dashes underscores and dots compare equivalently
